issues.failure_explanation: E v_h is defined only at interior vertices and vanishes at boundary vertices (E maps into S^1_0). The vertex bound max-min over the patch is therefore valid only for interior j; for a boundary vertex |v_h(j)-0| is controlled by the tangential trace of nabla v_h on boundary faces, which does not appear on the right-hand side (sum over interior faces only). Counterexample: on a square meshed with a center vertex, take v_h continuous P1 with values +a,-a,+a,-a at the four corners (zero at all boundary midpoints, so v_h in V_h). All interior tangential jumps vanish, so the right-hand side of (eq:Enrichment) is 0, but v_h - E v_h is nonzero (E v_h=0 at corners), so the left-hand side is positive.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add boundary faces to the right-hand side of (eq:Enrichment) with the tangential trace |\gamma_\tau \nabla v_h|_T| in place of the jump, and treat these faces in the proof of (eq:Enrichment2) by the Case-1 curl-bubble argument (the boundary term \int_T \nabla v\cdot curl b vanishes for v in W^{1,1}_0 and b vanishing on the other faces of T); no shift change is needed on boundary faces.
issues.overall_effect: Both estimates of Lemma confComp are unproven/false as stated, and every main result invokes this lemma to control e_h - E e_h.
issues.title: Enrichment estimate (eq:Enrichment) ignores boundary vertices; false as stated
